headline: AIB Raises Outlook Following Strong Rise in New Lending
summary: AIB reported a 2% rise in net interest income to €2.87 billion for the first nine months while new lending climbed to €12.3 billion, prompting the bank to raise its outlook.
why: AIB is a leading Irish commercial bank whose lending volumes and net interest income reflect broader domestic credit demand and economic activity.

impacts.name: Banking
impacts.why: Higher net interest income and increased loan originations improve the financial performance of retail banking institutions.
